tradeoff: Two additions the owner decided. /web/ is part of the standard deployment: paid by every deployment, a larger image (size unmeasured) carrying a pinned jellyfin-web that the project must keep licensed and updated. GET /Users/{userId}/Views is served for the Kodi add-on, Plezy and Tsukimi, as an exception to PRODUCT.md's rule that aliases exist only for routes jellyfin-web calls: given up, the rule's 'never', and one more route to keep until those clients stop calling it.
entry: JS-150 (the published image serves a pinned jellyfin-web at /web/, replaceable and switchable off) enters at priority 34, directly before JS-056, which now depends on it; the tasks at 34 to 71 each move down one. JS-151 (GET /Users/{userId}/Views) enters at 42, directly before JS-065, depending on JS-127, whose rule for a user id in the path applies; the tasks from JS-065 on move down one more. JS-151 observes Jellyfin 12.4 first: if the route is marked obsolete, PRODUCT.md's compatibility policy records the exception (the owner reviews the text) and compat/endpoints.yaml flags it alias with the three clients; if it is not, it is an ordinary route and PRODUCT.md is unchanged. D-026 holds: Plezy and Tsukimi are read from source for whether their players send a token, listed in docs/status.md accordingly, and no work goes in for one that sends none. Kodi stays not a gate. No other alias follows from this one.
